name: Carved Masjid
summary: A compressed mosque mass with a monumental pointed entrance and a square minaret cut into its left shoulder.
why: The hall and minaret form one continuous stepped outline. A wide pointed arch is removed from the center-right mass, while the connected left tower uses one narrow matching opening. The roof stays solid above both arches.
risk: Its low terraced body is deliberately abstract. The square minaret and pointed entrance carry the Islamic identity instead of a familiar dome.
sub1: A generous opening remains legible at launcher size
sub2: Steps, tower, and foundation form a continuous structure
theme: A solid mosque shaped by its doorway
reasonToChoose: You want a bold sculptural mosque with a distinctive balance of solid mass and generous openings.
